description: A small graveyard scene from the Little Structures datapack — headstones, iron fencing, a lantern or two, and patchy grass. A tidy vanilla build with a clean palette.

style_fit.rationale: Off-theme for the coastal Mediterranean-ruin brief — a village graveyard reads neither coastal nor ancient-ruin, and fills no current demand category. License-clean, so parked for a possible future graveyard/village theme.
